recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not alter the core DocumentReference operation list for FHIR-39624; any review of the moved API Incubator copy or broken incubator links should be handled as separate R6/API Incubator work.
issue_request: FHIR-39624 was a Published/Persuasive R5 OO change request for DocumentReference $generate. The operation definition output did not match the Bundle example, and the approved resolution was to change the OUT parameter name to return.
initial_application: The issue had already been applied. Local history commit 23fc079ad9c600783827a1618e197c2745f7185f changed the output parameter from docRef 0..1 DocumentReference to return 1..1 Bundle, matching the Bundle response example. Jira records an implementation link from March 2023 for the same applied work.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion concluded that a single out parameter named return with type Bundle is the correct way for the operation to return the Bundle directly. OO minutes from 2023-02-02 record the block vote containing FHIR-39624 as approved 14-0-0. Later R6 history removed DocumentReference-generate from the core DocumentReference operations list and ballot notes say DocumentReference.$generate moved to API Incubator, so a core operation-list edit would be out of scope for this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current local OperationDefinition source still defines the output as return, use out, min 1, max 1, type Bundle, and the checked example response is a Bundle containing a DocumentReference. The current core operation list includes $docref only, consistent with the later move of $generate out of core.
